method: Independent comparison of the full scoped base source text and permitted source diagrams against the frozen summary. All 10 board-action printed costs/effects and all 20 base Place costs/effects checked. Verification banner treated as an assertion, not evidence. No questions/keys, reader outputs/grades, material-fact files, prior audits, coverage reviews, adjudications, manifests or README read. No reader contact or repair authored.
conclusion: No material in-scope rule error or essential omission identified. The snapshot accurately states the scoped base game and narrow Town Hall clarification.
